tool_activity.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!*__pycache__*'"' -g '"'!*.pyc'"' && printf '%s\\n' '--- TASK.md ---' && sed -n '1,240p' TASK.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- materials files ---' && rg --files materials"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- candidate.py ---' && nl -ba candidate.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- material sizes ---' && wc -l materials/triton-semantics.rst materials/vector_add.py materials/standard.py materials/core.py materials/math.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- triton semantics (start) ---' && sed -n '1,260p' materials/triton-semantics.rst && printf '%s\\n' '--- vector_add.py ---' && sed -n '1,220p' materials/vector_add.py"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- relevant material references ---' && rg -n \"(tl\\.sum|sum\\(|atomic|num_warps|multiple_of|assume|dot|reduce|load|store)\" materials/standard.py materials/core.py materials/math.py | head -240 && printf '%s\\n' '--- standard.py opening ---' && sed -n '1,180p' materials/standard.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- core reduction/atomic excerpts ---' && sed -n '1,120p' materials/core.py && sed -n '780,900p' materials/core.py && sed -n '1750,1880p' materials/core.py"

reason: Reused the 32-element partial buffer as the scalar output view for the fixed 1,048,576-element fp32 case, removing one device allocation while retaining the tuned two-kernel Triton reduction.
